packages.name: Sonic 3 & Knuckles Native Widescreen (lock-on)
packages.author: segarecomp SEG-122
packages.supported_scope: Single-player Sonic route of the 4 MiB Sonic & Knuckles + Sonic 3 lock-on composite, built with the lock-on cartridge declaration. Native foreground, background where the level layout explains it, relocated HUD and widened actor coverage.
limitations: Only the exact 4 MiB lock-on composite is covered; standalone Sonic 3 or Sonic & Knuckles images are different identities.
Must be built as a declared lock-on cartridge (the launcher selects it automatically for this image; CLI builds need --mapper lock_on).
Some backgrounds still use the VDP's own wrapped scenery.
Some scenes may exhibit minor background wrapping (the VDP's own wrapped scenery), visual seams or other graphical imperfections.
Gameplay can differ slightly: additional actors and rings become active in the widened margins.
Sprite budget and per-line limits can be reached sooner in busy scenes.
